Q5779.reason: Common guidance is to flush a cannula at least every 8 hours (some say 12), and 8-hourly is the most common answer.

Q5782.reason: Appointing one clergy member to a secular commission has a secular purpose and no primary effect of advancing religion, and McDaniel v. Paty bars excluding clergy from office.
